children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - September 2, 2026) - Red Cloud Securities Inc. ("Red Cloud") is pleased to announce the appointment of Ian Parkinson as Managing Director, Equity Research, with a focus on base metals as of September 1, 2026.

Parkinson brings more than 25 years of mining industry and capital markets experience to Red Cloud, including 16 years as a sell-side mining analyst at leading Canadian investment dealers. Most recently, he served as Managing Director, Mining Equity Research at Stifel GMP, following senior research roles at GMP Securities and CIBC World Markets.

Before moving to the sell side, Parkinson spent a decade with Falconbridge and Noranda, now part of Glencore. His responsibilities spanned geology, exploration, metals marketing and business development, giving him a broad, first-hand understanding of the mining value chain.

More recently, Parkinson expanded his issuer-side experience through executive roles with Halcones Precious Metals and Emerita Resources, as well as serving as a director of Prospector Metals. This combination of technical, corporate and capital markets experience gives him a rare, multidimensional perspective on mining companies and investment opportunities.

"Ian is an experienced and highly regarded mining professionals in the Canadian capital markets," said Bruce Tatters, CEO of Red Cloud Securities. "His analytical depth, technical foundation and extensive industry relationships make him an exceptional addition to our firm. This is a major appointment for Red Cloud and further reinforces our commitment to building a best-in-class mining research platform."

David Talbot, Managing Director and Head of Research, added: "Ian's ability to assess mining companies through both a technical and capital markets lens will be enormously valuable to our clients. His appointment substantially strengthens our base metals research capabilities and adds further depth to an already highly specialized team."

"Red Cloud has built a differentiated platform with an exceptional focus on the global mining sector," said Parkinson. "I am excited to return to equity research and join a team known for its technical expertise, entrepreneurial culture and commitment to delivering actionable ideas to investors."
He holds a degree in Earth Science from Laurentian University in Sudbury, Ontario.

The appointment underscores Red Cloud's continued investment in industry-leading research and further strengthens the firm's position as a trusted source of mining intelligence for institutional investors and resource companies worldwide.

Red Cloud Securities Inc. is a CIRO-regulated investment dealer specializing in delivering comprehensive capital market services and innovative financing solutions to the junior resource sector. Founded by experienced capital markets professionals with a deep understanding of the junior mining industry, the company is committed to providing exceptional services.

title: Red Cloud Securities Appoints Veteran Mining Analyst Ian Parkinson as Managing Director, Equity Research
